summary: Motorola Solutions filed an 8-K announcing its board authorized a $2.0 billion increase to its share repurchase program, raising total authorization to $20 billion with no expiration. Under the prior $18 billion program, about $0.6 billion remained at Q2 2026 end, and roughly $17.4 billion of shares had been repurchased through July 4, 2026. Repurchases may occur in the open market or privately negotiated transactions subject to market conditions. No advisor or price terms are stated. The buyback signals continued capital-return support, with watch items being execution pace, leverage, and any shift in free cash flow.
